description: This file contains common platform definitions, macros, and function declarations for the libgit2 library, including version info, feature flags, and global options.

methods.name: git_libgit2_version
methods.description: Returns the version numbers of the libgit2 library.

methods.name: git_libgit2_features
methods.description: Returns a bitmask of features with which libgit2 was compiled.

methods.name: git_libgit2_opts
methods.description: Sets or queries global options for libgit2.
